title: "RV2002: Resumable ref callback must assign a local"

**Severity:** error · **Area:** Resume (`RV2xxx`) · **Quick fix:** yes

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Resumable ref callbacks must assign a local: ref={(el) => (local = el)}
```

## How to fix

Use an element ref: const el = `ref<HTMLDivElement>()`; `<div ref={el} />`, or assign a local: `ref={(e) => (el = e)}`.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export function A() { return <div ref={(el) => el.focus()} onClick={() => 1} />; }
```

```tsx prefer
import { ref } from "@rivetjs/runtime/dom";
export function A() { const divRef = ref<HTMLDivElement>(); return <div ref={divRef} onClick={() => 1} />; }
```

## Quick fix

The [language service](../guides/tooling/language-service.md) (editor) and the MCP `check_code` tool offer these code actions:

- Use an element ref: const `{name}` = `ref<…>()`; `ref={{name}}`
- Bind the element to a local: `ref={(el) => ({name} = el)}`

## When it is reported

Resume mode.
